scope: Secondary mechanistic experiment, predeclared before basal ranking; primary potency/quiet-basal objective unchanged
hypothesis: A ligand-free state-energy surrogate should be better matched to basal activation than to ligand sensitivity
basal_gain: Both biological repeat basal activity >=1.5 times their matched synonymous WT reference
constraint: Both repeat 5uM saturated activity >=0.8 times reference
partition: Reuse fixed native-site train/validation/test; no threshold tuning to observed positive counts
interpretation: Reporter gain, not proven intrinsic receptor efficacy; expression remains a confounder
